staffRolesDesiredNotAssigned.name: 版务 · Moderator
staffRolesDesiredNotAssigned.permissions: manual least privilege for moderation; no Administrator by default

permissionRules: All 21 member-facing language, character, interest, and notification roles are cosmetic/opt-in only; no administrative permissions, no staff-area access, and no channel gating.
Notification roles remain unassigned unless the member explicitly opts in; interest/language/character selection never triggers a ping.
Staff roles are never offered through onboarding and are assigned manually only after owner review. Do not grant Administrator by default.

moderation.publicStandard: General-audience SFW; no harassment, hate, threats, doxxing, spam, scams, phishing, or impersonation. Constructive criticism of the game is welcome.
moderation.spoilers: Use Discord spoiler tags and label story/endgame spoiler scope.
moderation.sensitiveData: Never request or publish passwords, login tokens, complete save files, or personal data. Staff do not request credentials.
moderation.permissions: Keep information, announcement, roles, and known-issues channels read-only for members; keep intended public chat/forums writable; keep staff channels private through explicit permissions.
moderation.safeguards: Review AutoMod, mention-spam and raid-protection settings; provide a human appeal/review path. Avoid @everyone/@here during setup.
moderation.support: Manual staff handling only until a private-support workflow is verified. Do not advertise a bot, slash command, response-time guarantee, or automatic ticketing.

onboardingReference: onboarding-spec.json: original seven defaults plus two public feedback forums (9 total), preserving the original five writable chats; language required, interest/favorites optional, notifications separately opt-in, staff excluded from self-selection. Actual saved status belongs in server-state.json.
archivePolicy: Archive first, analyze later is the policy goal. No archive bot or AI processing is installed or enabled yet; this blueprint does not state that archive-first processing is operational. The proposed scope covers public text channels/forums/threads, not staff private spaces or DMs; retention, access, edits/deletions, and deletion requests must be defined and verified before activation.
